keyEvents.text: Own Goal by Nathan Harriel, Philadelphia Union. New England Revolution 1, Philadelphia Union 0.
Nathan Harriel (Philadelphia Union) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Will Sands (New England Revolution) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Jack Harrison replaces Dániel Gazdag.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Indiana Vassilev replaces Milan Iloski.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Jesús Bueno replaces Jovan Lukic.

Goal! New England Revolution 2, Philadelphia Union 0. Peyton Miller (New England Revolution) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the top left corner. Assisted by Jack Harrison with a cross following a corner.
Kai Wagner (Philadelphia Union) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Ezekiel Alladoh replaces Frankie Westfield.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Alhassan Yusuf replaces Carles Gil because of an injury.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Agustín Anello replaces Quinn Sullivan.
Substitution, New England Revolution. Luca Langoni replaces Dor Turgeman.
